subject: Kiosk KSK-0003-01 caught in continuous restart loop
description: The self-service ordering kiosk at Vijayanagar location is experiencing repeated software crashes and rebooting automatically every 30-40 seconds. The device boots to the ServeWell Kiosk v2.1 splash screen, attempts to load the menu, then crashes and restarts without completing initialization. This has been ongoing since approximately 1:30 PM today, preventing customers from placing orders via the kiosk. Store staff has attempted a single power cycle without resolution.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and assigned. Remote diagnostics queued; initial assessment suggests possible database connectivity issue or corrupted cache on device. Advised store manager to power down kiosk and await further instructions.
